scope: Frozen released FACT seed55 native execution; no clean edit split, no five-seed paper mean, no independent retraining.

binding.environment_limit: Frozen environment configuration/dependency binaries are bound; runtime-command receipt does not capture the complete effective process environment.

provenance_adjudication.basis: All master inputs bind:300 SAGE frozen copies and2 external dependency wheels; only original preparation manifest drifted. Its diff updates three observation-file hash descriptions, two export defaults, and removes response metadata. Native startup/model/data code has no read/reference to that manifest.
provenance_adjudication.boundary: Static source and runtime-path evidence, not OS file-access tracing. Original failed producer receipt remains failed; controller owns any formal adjudication/promotion.

source.inference_basis: LKGE/TransE have no embedding/predict/norm/post-processing override; BaseModel.embedding returns raw weights, normal predict scores them directly. Mapping is trained after post_train evaluation.

selection_limit: Validation MRR only checked through four-decimal native metric represented as percent with two decimals in logs and selected epoch/checkpoint bytes; validation ranks/scores not independently exported or recomputed.

sampled_replay.scope: 15 selected post_train raw embedding checkpoints. Mapping/training buffers not needed by proven native scorer.
sampled_replay.exclusions: No post_expand/pre_fwt exact replay: no corresponding mapping evaluation state/checkpoint association proved.
sampled_replay.ties: Exact CPU ranks and GPU export rank membership in exact-score tie intervals separately reported.

limitations: Producer source integrity failure retained; any metadata-only adjudication/promotion belongs to controller.
15 post_train files may have sampled checkpoint inference;10 post_expand and4 pre_fwt only query/filter/count/metric audits.
No independent validation rank recomputation; selection is logged metric/epoch/byte-lineage consistency.
Fixed dimension schedule180/210/250/270/290 and replay normalization follow released implementation; paper algorithm equivalence is not established.
Native candidate/filter universe is historical query snapshot; not frozen clean edit protocol.
One seed55 run is not the five-seed paper mean.
Native training-loop sum excludes training-data selection, mapping training and full evaluation/launch overhead.
